weakest_scene.root_cause: The relationship is SHARE: 68% of people live in the hottest pockets, and the other 32% are the rest of the same whole. The scene drew it as a DISTANCE between two separate measurements, which invents a '36% apart' claim the script never makes. This is the wrong relationship for the data.
